body:
User asked (verbatim): "ok add those to task"

Context: answering what "accept the vendor picks" means. I said the picks (Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Vercel Blob, Cloudinary; Google Cloud Vision for contrib/vision) stay, and suggested Box instead of or beside Dropbox, and AWS Rekognition or Azure AI Vision beside Google; contrib/vision has a backend interface, so a provider is one more sub-package.

Acceptance: a sub-package beside contrib/vision/google implementing the same backend interface, tests against a fake server, README and docs.
title: contrib/vision/azure: Azure AI Vision backend
